# betterado_group_entitlement (Resource)

Manages a group entitlement within Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_group_entitlement" "example" {
  display_name         = "MyTeamGroup"
  origin               = "vsts"
  origin_id            = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  account_license_type = "express"
  licensing_source     = "account"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_license_type` (String) The account license type of the group. Defaults to 'express'.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the group.
- `licensing_source` (String) The licensing source of the group. Defaults to 'account'.
- `origin` (String) The origin of the group, e.g. 'aad' or 'vsts'.
- `origin_id` (String) The origin ID of the group. Used when origin is set.

### Read-Only

- `descriptor` (String) The descriptor of the group.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `principal_name` (String) The principal name of the group.
